verdict.rationale: pnpm exposes only a standard human-oriented CLI reference (pnpm-cli); explicit probes for machine-readable/API surfaces (llms.txt, docs-in-markdown, OpenAPI/swagger) all returned 404, and no evidence shows a documented JSON API, SDK, or scriptable output contract for AI-native automation. missing for 10: llms.txt or machine-readable docs, an OpenAPI/REST API or SDK, documented JSON output modes for programmatic consumption.
